settings.title: Settings
settings.fontFamily.hint: Fonts are not bundled with the app. A font only takes effect if it is installed on this device; otherwise the system monospace font is used.
settings.fontLigatures.hint: Draws symbol pairs like =>, != and >= as single glyphs. Only works with fonts that support ligatures, such as Fira Code or JetBrains Mono.
notice.notTextFile: {{name}} is not an editable text file, so it was not opened
notice.demoReadFailed: Failed to read the demo sources: {{message}}
notice.demosSaved_one: Saved {{count}} demo to {{label}}. You can edit them now — Ctrl+S writes back to disk.
notice.demosSaved_other: Saved {{count}} demos to {{label}}. You can edit them now — Ctrl+S writes back to disk.
notice.demosSavedClosed_one: Saved {{count}} demo to {{label}}; not opened on the left. To edit them here, use "Open folder" on that directory.
notice.demosSavedClosed_other: Saved {{count}} demos to {{label}}; not opened on the left. To edit them here, use "Open folder" on that directory.
notice.demoSaveCleaned_one: Cleaned up {{count}} incomplete demo folder left from a previous save
notice.demoSaveCleaned_other: Cleaned up {{count}} incomplete demo folders left from a previous save
notice.demoSaveGone: The incomplete folder from the previous save is already gone; nothing to clean up
notice.draftWillSaveTo: Type a file name on the left and press Enter to save it to {{path}}
notice.noWriteTarget: This file is not inside a local folder, so there is nowhere to write it back — downloaded instead
notice.externalChanged: {{name}} changed on disk while you still have unsaved edits; saving will overwrite the version on disk
notice.reloaded: {{name}} was reloaded from the latest version on disk
notice.createdButEmpty: {{name}} was created, but its content could not be written: {{message}}
editor.runDisabled: The runner only executes JavaScript / TypeScript
confirm.closeMany.title_one: Do you want to save the changes to this file?
confirm.closeMany.title_other: Do you want to save the changes to these {{count}} files?
confirm.closeMany.unsaved: Your changes will be lost if you don't save them.
confirm.discardMany.body: These unsaved changes will be lost.
confirm.discardTab.title: Close {{name}}?
confirm.discardTab.unsaved: This file has unsaved changes that will be lost if you close it.
confirm.discardTab.untitled: It has never been saved. Closing it discards its content.
confirm.closeTab.title: Do you want to save the changes to {{name}}?
confirm.closeTab.unsaved: Your changes will be lost if you don't save them.
panes.resize: Drag to resize the editor and output panels
confirm.cancelSave.title: Stop the save?
confirm.cancelSave.body: Writing will stop and the incomplete files already written will be deleted, restoring to before the save.
confirm.cleanupInterrupted.title: Clean up an incomplete save?
confirm.cleanupInterrupted.bodyMultiple: Incomplete files from an interrupted save were found in {{labels}}. Delete them?
confirm.cleanupInterrupted.bodyRecord: A previous save was interrupted (page refresh or close); incomplete files were left in {{label}}. Delete them?
confirm.saveDemos.title: Save all demos locally?
confirm.saveDemos.body_one: All {{count}} demo will be saved into the folder you pick, creating a subfolder there. Continue?
confirm.saveDemos.body_other: All {{count}} demos will be saved into the folder you pick, creating a subfolder there. Continue?
confirm.openDemos.title: Open the saved folder on the left?
confirm.openDemos.body_one: Saved {{count}} demo to {{label}}. Open this folder in the file panel on the left to edit them?
confirm.openDemos.body_other: Saved {{count}} demos to {{label}}. Open this folder in the file panel on the left to edit them?
confirm.delete.title: Delete {{name}}?
confirm.delete.dir: This will delete {{path}} and everything inside it.
confirm.delete.unsavedInDir_one: {{count}} open file inside it has unsaved changes and will be deleted too.
confirm.delete.unsavedInDir_other: {{count}} open files inside it have unsaved changes and will be deleted too.
confirm.delete.unsavedFile: This file has unsaved changes, which will be deleted too.
confirm.delete.irreversible: Deleting writes straight to disk: no recycle bin, and no way to undo it.
confirm.closeRoot.title: Remove {{name}}?
confirm.closeRoot.listOnly: This only takes it off the list on the left. Nothing on disk changes.
confirm.closeRoot.openFiles_one: {{count}} open file from it will be closed.
confirm.closeRoot.openFiles_other: {{count}} open files from it will be closed.
confirm.closeRoot.openFilesUnsaved_one: {{count}} open file from it will be closed, and {{unsaved}} with unsaved changes will be discarded.
confirm.closeRoot.openFilesUnsaved_other: {{count}} open files from it will be closed, and {{unsaved}} with unsaved changes will be discarded.
confirm.closeRoot.reauth: To use it again you have to pick the folder once more. Browser security rules keep a page from holding on to that permission by itself.
confirm.renameDir.title: Rename {{from}} to {{to}}?
confirm.renameDir.how: Browsers offer no directory rename API, so the whole folder is copied under the new name and the original is deleted only once every file has been copied.
confirm.renameDir.size_one: {{files}} file, {{size}} in total. Please keep this page open while it copies.
confirm.renameDir.size_other: {{files}} files, {{size}} in total. Please keep this page open while it copies.
confirm.renameDir.risk: Copied files get their modification time reset to now. If the copy fails halfway the original stays untouched, but a half-copied folder is left on disk.
sidebar.unsupported: This browser cannot open local folders — only Chromium-based browsers such as Chrome and Edge implement that API. You can still use "{{label}}" at the top to open a single file.
sidebar.reauthHint: Folders marked "{{label}}" come back with a single click — the browser asks again every time the page reloads
sidebar.truncated: Too many entries, showing the first {{max}}
sidebar.rootLocked: Click here to grant access to {{name}} again
sidebar.rootMissing: The folder {{name}} cannot be found — it may have been moved, renamed, or deleted. Click here to try again once it is back, or right-click to remove it
sidebar.rootHint: {{name}} (click to expand / collapse and make it the target for new entries; right-click for more)
sidebar.saveDemos: Save every demo to a local folder
validate.tooLong: The name is too long — 255 characters at most
validate.dots: "." and ".." cannot be used as a name
validate.slash: The name cannot contain a slash — new entries always go into the current folder
validate.illegalChars: The name cannot contain < > : " | ? * or similar characters
validate.control: The name cannot contain control characters
validate.trailing: The name cannot end with a dot or a space
validate.reserved: {{name}} collides with a reserved system name, please pick another
validate.exists: {{name}} already exists, please pick another name
validate.createExt: Only editable text files can be created (.js / .ts / .json / .md and the like)
validate.renameExt: That extension would make the file unopenable here — use .js / .ts / .json / .md or similar
err.fs.noPicker: This browser cannot open local folders
err.fs.notAllowed: No permission to access this file or folder (it may be locked by another program, read-only, or access was revoked)
err.fs.tooLarge: {{name}} is {{size}}, over the {{max}} limit, so it was not opened
err.fs.binary: {{name}} looks like a binary file, so it was not opened
err.fs.nameTaken: {{name}} already exists, please pick another name
err.fs.nameTaken_file: {{name}} already exists (file), please pick another name
err.fs.nameTaken_directory: {{name}} already exists (folder), please pick another name
err.fs.uniqueExhausted: {{base}} and the 99 numbered names after it are all taken, clean up the target folder first
err.fs.caseRenameUnsupported: This browser cannot rename an entry to a name that differs only in case. Rename it to something else first, then to the name you want.
err.fs.ignoredDirInTree: The folder contains {{name}}; copying a folder like that makes no sense. Rename it in your system file manager instead.
err.fs.treeTooManyFiles_one: The folder holds more than {{max}} file, which is too much to copy wholesale. Rename it in your system file manager instead.
err.fs.treeTooManyFiles_other: The folder holds more than {{max}} files, which is too much to copy wholesale. Rename it in your system file manager instead.
err.fs.treeTooLarge: The folder holds more than {{max}}, which is too much to copy wholesale. Rename it in your system file manager instead.
err.idb.blocked: IndexedDB is blocked by another tab
err.imports.bare: {{from}} imports "{{spec}}", which is an npm package. Importing third-party packages is not supported yet; only relative imports of files inside the opened folder work.
err.imports.noRoot: This file is not inside an opened folder (a scratch, a built-in demo or an imported file), so relative imports cannot be resolved. Save it into a folder and run it from there.
err.imports.notFound: "{{spec}}" imported by {{from}} was not found. Tried: {{tried, list}}.
err.imports.outsideRoot: "{{spec}}" imported by {{from}} points outside the opened folder and cannot be imported.
err.imports.unsupportedType: "{{spec}}" imported by {{from}} is not a runnable JS / TS file. Only .js, .mjs, .ts and .mts are supported.
err.imports.cycle: Circular import: {{chain, chain}}. This runtime does not support circular dependencies; break one link of the cycle.
err.imports.tooMany: More than {{limit}} files imported, stopped. Check whether a folder like node_modules is being imported.
err.ws.rootMoved: The folder {{name}} is no longer where it was. Once it is back, click it to reconnect; otherwise right-click to remove it
err.ws.permissionDenied: Could not get access to {{name}}. Click it again, or close it and open it anew.
err.ws.permissionUnavailable: This browser cannot restore the folder from last time, please open it again
err.ws.dirStale: The folder {{name}} can no longer be opened, please refresh
err.ws.dirGone: That folder is no longer on disk, please refresh and try again
err.ws.parentGone: The target folder is gone, refresh and try again
err.ws.parentStale: The target folder can no longer be opened, try refreshing
err.ws.holderGone: The folder it lives in is gone, refresh and try again
err.ws.entryStale: {{name}} can no longer be opened, please refresh
err.ws.entryMissing: {{name}} is no longer on disk, please refresh
